
{{alias}}( str )
    Returns a normalized string that can be parsed as JSON.

    Parameters
    ----------
    str: string
        String to parse.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string
        Normalized string that can be parsed as JSON.

    Examples
    --------
    > var obj = {{alias}}( '{ beep: "boop" }' )
    '{ "beep": "boop" }'

    See Also
    --------
